items.description: Tenant must pay Base Rent to Landlord throughout the Term of the Lease.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay Base Rent to Landlord throughout the Term of this Lease.

items.description: Base Rent is payable in monthly installments in advance on the first day of each calendar month during the Term.
items.span_text: All Base Rent shall be paid to Landlord in monthly installments in advance on the first day of each and every calendar month throughout the Term of this Lease

items.description: Tenant is prohibited from paying any Rent installment more than one month in advance.
items.span_text: Tenant shall not pay any installment of Rent more than one (1) month in advance.

items.description: Landlord and Tenant are each responsible for the installation fees set out in Exhibit E.
items.span_text: Landlord and Tenant shall be responsible for the fees as set forth on Exhibit “E”.

items.description: Tenant must pay Base Rent and Additional Rent when due, without notice or demand, in lawful US money and without abatement, offset or deduction except as the Lease provides.
items.span_text: Base Rent and all forms of Additional Rent payable hereunder by Tenant (i) shall be payable to Landlord when due, without any prior notice or demand therefor, in lawful money of the United States without any abatement, offset or deduction whatsoever

items.description: If Rent is not received by the Delinquency Date, Tenant must pay a Late Charge and Late Payment Interest as Additional Rent.
items.span_text: if Landlord has not received any payment of Rent on or before the Delinquency Date, Tenant shall, in addition to Tenant’s obligation to pay the Late Payment to Landlord, also be required to pay to Landlord, as Additional Rent, (i) a Late Charge, and (ii) Late Payment Interest
items.trigger: if Landlord has not received any payment of Rent on or before the Delinquency Date

items.description: Landlord waives the Late Charge for the first late payment in any twelve-month period.
items.span_text: Landlord hereby agrees to waive the Late Charge with respect to the first late payment in any twelve-(12)-month period.

items.description: Tenant must use best practices for hot-aisle containment, including blanking plates, throughout the Premises at all times during the Term.
items.span_text: Tenant hereby agrees to use best practices related to hot-aisle containment (including the use of blanking plates) with regard to the entirety of the Premises at all times during the Term.

items.description: Tenant must pay the cost of all utilities serving or used in the Tenant Space.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay the cost of all utilities (e.g., electricity, chilled water) serving, provided to and/or used in or for the Tenant Space.

items.anchor_event: Tenant’s receipt of each Tenant’s Utility Payment invoice
items.description: Tenant must pay each Utility Payment as Additional Rent within thirty days after receiving the invoice.
items.span_text: Tenant shall pay Tenant’s Utility Payment to Landlord, as Additional Rent, within thirty (30) days after Tenant’s receipt of each Tenant’s Utility Payment invoice.

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant an annual statement comparing Utility Payments (Default) for PUE Capped Months with and without the PUE Cost Recovery Factor, by June 15 after each calendar year or as soon as reasonably possible.
items.span_text: Landlord shall provide Tenant a statement on or before June 15 (or as soon thereafter as reasonably possible) after the end of each calendar year

items.description: Landlord must pay Tenant the difference within thirty days after Tenant receives the statement.
items.span_text: Landlord shall pay to Tenant, within thirty (30) days following Tenant’s receipt of such statement, the amount of the difference.
items.trigger: If the aggregate of Tenant’s Utility Payments (Default), as affected by the PUE Cost Recovery Factor for the PUE Capped Months is less than the aggregate of Tenant’s Utility Payments (Default) that would have been collected by Landlord from Tenant during such months without taking the PUE Cost Recovery Factor calculation into consideration
